authority: #K2-555 (R1852 approved) STEP 3a - the STANDARD IS DATA (auditable; never a code constant). This pins the objective, the enumeration law, the hard caps and the tie-break BEFORE any enumerator is written (declaration first), exactly as the construction order requires.
scope: K2 is the TEST CASE; the standard is generic (no per-board special case).

terms.blocks_crossed: the number of DECLARED blocks a net's endpoints span (from the declared partition, a DATA input - never inferred here)
terms.block_centre_distance: Euclidean distance between the centres of the two blocks the net spans; a net inside ONE block contributes 0

power_proximity_penalty.applies_to: power nets vs their plane layer

weights.note: dimensionless-by-construction: the distance term is in mm and the crossing count is an integer; the weights are 1.0 and are REGISTERED (changing them is a standard revision, not a code edit)

enumeration_law.why: block permutations are label-symmetric - enumerating them adds no solution, only cost

candidate_positions.step_mm_note: the declared quantisation (4 decimals on the registered frame) -> as a NUMBER this is 10^-4 mm (the standard must be machine-readable; the prose stays here)

hard_caps.why: keeps the enumeration arithmetically bounded: <= 8^4 = 4096 combinations per window worst case, evaluated by the registered objective - no search, no backtracking

enumeration_law.tie_break_note: explicit and total: the same input always yields the same chosen placement

determinism_rules.tolerances: every geometric predicate carries an EXPLICIT tolerance; coordinates compare with 1e-3 mm (the 1e-6 boundary class was measured on this project)
determinism_rules.proof_harness: two runs must produce byte-identical ledgers (the in-register K2MR_NOCACHE-style double run); the score table is part of the ledger

gates_reused_not_forked.C2_caliber: copy the registered caliber (total <= cap AND new_classes == []); never fork a second DRC caliber
gates_reused_not_forked.C6_gauge: use block.outside_copper_equivalent with its derived per-row tolerances; never fork
gates_reused_not_forked.connectivity: compare ISLAND PARTITIONS (f1.islands), never DRC rows (the DRC picks an arbitrary representative item)
gates_reused_not_forked.blocked_counts: the refusal counts are taken AFTER removing same-island no-ops (#K2-554/#K2-544: the polluted criterion)

acceptance.fail_closed: C1 == 0 AND C2 PASS AND new_classes == [] => book the closure; otherwise name per-item causes and STOP (no second run is pre-authorised)

files: the position enumerator + the score table writer
must_not: no search beyond the hard caps
no code constant for any weight or cap
